clips.title: The story
paras: Petitioners wait for the crown in a chamber just inside Stormwind Keep. Nobles, church dignitaries, and visiting subjects spend the time mingling, drinking, or awaiting an audience.

The Petitioner's Chamber lies just to the right as you enter Stormwind Keep. Count Remington Ridgewell and Bishop DeLavey wait there for audiences with boy-king Anduin Wrynn and Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Between formal visits, the chamber gives nobles and clergy room to mingle, trade gossip, and quietly press their concerns. Who holds influence in the realm can often be seen in who speaks with whom.
